paragraphs: Hyman reports him in the old printings at Shabbat 17a, whereas the text Hyman uses reads Avimi. Compare [Shabbat 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.17b.4).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Shabbat 17b reads אמר באלי אמר אבימי סנוותאה. Hyman cites 17a and supplies Avivi Sagvata for old printings. His report of those printings is distinct from this digital witness.
The linked Bavli has Bali transmitting in the name of Avimi Sinvataa. Hyman cites 17a and reports Avivi Sagvata from early printings. The linked text establishes its own reading.
